'''2013 Worlds Day 1 Aaron Kia DS Walker Garrison''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kia]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Walker Garrison|ESB2P-D-walkergarrison.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
